title: Performance-Driven Policy Optimization for Speculative Decoding with Adaptive Windowing
abstract: arXiv:2605.14978v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by having a lightweight draft model propose speculative windows of candidate tokens for parallel verification by a larger target model. In practice, speculative efficiency is often bottlenecked by hard-to-draft positions, where an early mismatch truncates the accepted prefix and invalidates the rest of the speculative window. Most learning-based drafters are still optimized with token-level supervised objectives, even though speculative utility is inherently window-level and prefix-sensitive. We propose PPOW (Performance-Driven Policy Optimization with Adaptive Windowing), a reinforcement learning framework that shifts drafter optimization from token-level imitation to window-level optimization. PPOW combines a Cost-Aware Speedup Reward, a Distribution-Based Proximity Reward, and Adaptive Divergence-Aware Windowing, which prioritizes informative windows with high confidence-weighted draf

translated_title: 面向推测解码的性能驱动策略优化与自适应窗口机制
translated_abstract: 推测解码通过让轻量级草稿模型提出候选token的推测窗口，再由更大的目标模型进行并行验证，从而加速大语言模型（LLM）的推理。在实践中，推测效率往往受限于难以起草的位置——在这些位置上，早期的不匹配会截断已被接受的前缀，并使推测窗口的其余部分失效。尽管推测效用本质上是窗口级别且对前缀敏感的，但大多数基于学习的草稿模型仍然使用token级别的监督目标进行优化。我们提出了PPOW（性能驱动的策略优化与自适应窗口机制），这是一个强化学习框架，将草稿模型的优化从token级别的模仿转变为窗口级别的优化。PPOW结合了成本感知加速奖励、基于分布的接近度奖励以及自适应散度感知窗口机制，优先处理具有高置信度加权草稿的信息丰富窗口。
tldr: 提出PPOW强化学习框架，将推测解码中草稿模型的优化从token级模仿提升到窗口级优化，通过成本感知加速奖励、分布接近度奖励和自适应散度感知窗口机制，有效解决难起草位置导致的推测效率瓶颈，加速LLM推理。
en_tdlr: PPOW is a reinforcement learning framework that shifts speculative decoding drafter optimization from token-level imitation to window-level optimization, combining a cost-aware speedup reward, a distribution-based proximity reward, and adaptive divergence-aware windowing to overcome the efficiency bottleneck at hard-to-draft positions and accelerate LLM inference.
